comparison.objective: Transfer sterile instruments to a sterile field without contamination; candidate removes open cartons while preserving contents and leaving closed cartons untouched.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2077 tests precise rigid-instrument pickup and placement while avoiding forbidden surfaces, including contamination transfer from grippers. Candidate tests moving loaded-container grasp, flap avoidance and level transport.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2077 requires four sterile, flat, separated placements, 3 cm clearance and 1 s stability; border/table contamination is permanent. Candidate requires open-carton tray rejection, no content escape, 60 mm clearance, 3 s dwell and closed-carton passage.
comparison.reason: Both latch contact-related damage, but sterile-surface avoidance and loaded moving-carton rejection are different tested abilities.
